title: Kenyan Caraway Seed Biscuit
description: A sweet and savory biscuit from Kenya, flavored with caraway seeds. Perfect as a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and caraway seeds.
Add in butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg and milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead a few times until it comes together.
Roll the dough out to about 1 inch thickness.
Cut into desired shapes using a biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 18-20 minutes, or until the biscuits are golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
